title: Two or more wythes.
officialText:
The fire-resistance rating for wall panels consisting of two or more wythes
shall be permitted to be determined by the formula:
R = (R 0.59 +R 0.59 + ... + Rn0.59) (Equation 7-4)
1 2 1.7
where:
R = The fire endurance of the assembly, minutes.
R , R , and R = The fire endurances of the individual wythes, minutes. Values of R 0.59 for use in Equation 7-4
1 2 n n
are given in Table 721.2.1.2(1). Calculated fire-resistance ratings are shown in Table 721.2.1.2(2).
